english.title: Engage in activity requiring a licence when not a licensee
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) engaged in an activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), for which a licence under the Consumer Credit Act 1974 was required, when not a licensee under a licence covering that activity
english.legislation: Contrary to section 39(1) of, and Schedule 1 to, the Consumer Credit Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
engaged in an activity for which a licence under the Consumer Credit Act 1974 was required
when not a licensee under a licence covering that activity

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Cymryd rhan mewn gweithgaredd y mae angen trwydded ar ei gyfer a chithau ddim yn drwyddedai
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i chi gymryd rhan mewn gweithgaredd, sef **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), yr oedd yn rhaid cael trwydded dan Ddeddf Credyd Defnyddwyr 1974 ar ei gyfer, a chithau ddim yn drwyddedai dan drwydded ar gyfer y gweithgaredd hwnnw
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i Adran 39(1) ac Atodlen 1 Deddf Credyd Defnyddwyr 1974.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and a fine or both

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
